question: How should the entire group of fire-pit walls be ritually adorned?
premises: The fire-pit has a group of walls.
All of these walls are included in the rite.
The armor mantra is the means of adornment.
inference: Therefore, one should adorn all the walls of the fire-pit using the armor mantra.
plain_english: One should adorn the entire group of the fire-pit walls with the armor mantra.
